'''Mechs''' were a type of [[walker]] used by those who called the [[poison]]ed [[planet]] [[Carnelion IV]] their [[homeworld]]. The faction called [[Open]] utilized mechs during the [[mission to Carnelion IV]], the last skirmish of the [[Open-Closed War|Open-Closed war]].<ref name="Anakin 5" /> [[Mandalorian]] [[Foundling]], [[Din Grogu]] piloted the repurposed [[IG-12]] mech during the [[Liberation of Mandalore]] after a group of [[Anzellan Droidsmiths]] rebuilt the droid from [[IG-11]] on [[Nevarro]].<ref name="Chapter 23">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 23: The Spies}}</ref> The mech was badly damaged by a trio of [[Praetorian Guard|praetorian guards]] but later recovered and rebuilt back into IG-11.<ref name="Chapter 24">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 24: The Return}}</ref>
